R Notebook

  1. Split earthquakes into train/test
  2. calculate best_lambda using only train_data
  3. create the Box–Cox response
  4. fit models
  5. predict test data
  6. inverse Box–Cox predictions
  7. calculate RMSE in MMI units.
# LIBRARIES
library(arrow)
library(MASS)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(lme4)
library(here)
library(ggspatial)
library(ggnewscale)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
# LOAD DATA
data <- read_parquet(
  here(
    "data_processed",
    "NZ_FR_IAR_final_dataset.parquet"
  )
)

# CHECK DATA
expected_columns <- c(
  "publicid",
  "cell_id",
  "origintime",
  "event_longitude",
  "event_latitude",
  "event_depth_km",
  "report_longitude",
  "report_latitude",
  "reported_mmi",
  "report_count",
  "Mw",
  "Repi_km",
  "Rhypo_km",
  "Vs30_m_s"
)

# Check all expected columns are present
stopifnot(
  all(expected_columns %in% names(data))
)

# Check earthquake-cell combinations are unique
stopifnot(
  nrow(data) ==
    nrow(
      distinct(
        data,
        publicid,
        cell_id
      )
    )
)

# Check important values are usable
stopifnot(
  all(data$report_count >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  all(data$Rhypo_km >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  all(data$Repi_km >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  all(data$event_depth_km >= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  all(data$reported_mmi > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# Confirm existing earthquake selection rules
stopifnot(
  all(
    data$origintime >=
      as.POSIXct(
        "2016-09-01",
        tz = "UTC"
      )
  ),
  all(
    data$Mw >= 3.5,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)

# Check earthquake-level attributes are consistent
event_check <- data |>
  group_by(publicid) |>
  summarise(
    n_origintime = n_distinct(origintime),
    n_event_longitude = n_distinct(event_longitude),
    n_event_latitude = n_distinct(event_latitude),
    n_event_depth = n_distinct(event_depth_km),
    n_Mw = n_distinct(Mw),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(
  all(event_check$n_origintime == 1),
  all(event_check$n_event_longitude == 1),
  all(event_check$n_event_latitude == 1),
  all(event_check$n_event_depth == 1),
  all(event_check$n_Mw == 1)
)

# REPORT COUNT FILTERING
minimum_reports_per_cell <- 4

# EARTHQUAKE THRESHOLDS
minimum_reports_per_earthquake <- 4


data_sd <- data |>
  filter(
    report_count >= minimum_reports_per_cell
  ) |>
  group_by(publicid) |>
  mutate(
    total_reports = sum(
      report_count,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    total_reports >= minimum_reports_per_earthquake
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# CHECK LOG TRANSFORMATIONS
stopifnot(
  all(
    data_sd$Repi_km > 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  all(
    data_sd$Vs30_m_s > 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)

# 80 / 20 TRAIN-TEST SPLIT BY EARTHQUAKE
set.seed(123)


# Get unique earthquakes
earthquake_ids <- unique(
  data_sd$publicid
)


# Randomly select 80% of earthquakes for training
train_ids <- sample(
  earthquake_ids,
  size = floor(
    0.8 * length(earthquake_ids)
  )
)

# Split data by earthquake
train_data <- data_sd |>
  filter(
    publicid %in% train_ids
  )


test_data <- data_sd |>
  filter(
    !publicid %in% train_ids
  )

# Check split
cat(
  "Training earthquakes:",
  n_distinct(train_data$publicid),
  "\n"
)
Training earthquakes: 825 
cat(
  "Testing earthquakes:",
  n_distinct(test_data$publicid),
  "\n"
)
Testing earthquakes: 207 
# BOX-COX FUNCTIONS
boxcox_transform <- function(
  y,
  lambda,
  tol = 1e-8
) {

  if (any(y <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    stop(
      "Box-Cox transformation requires positive response values."
    )
  }

  if (abs(lambda) < tol) {

    log(y)

  } else {

    (y^lambda - 1) / lambda

  }
}


inverse_boxcox <- function(
  z,
  lambda,
  tol = 1e-8
) {

  if (abs(lambda) < tol) {
    return(
      exp(z)
    )
  }

  inside <- 1 + lambda * z

  result <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    length(z)
  )

  valid <- is.finite(inside) & inside > 0

  result[valid] <-
    inside[valid]^(1 / lambda)

  if (any(!valid)) {

    warning(
      "Some Box-Cox predictions could not be back-transformed."
    )

  }

  return(result)
}

# CREATE 5 CROSS-VALIDATION FOLDS
set.seed(123)

k <- 5


# Get unique TRAINING earthquakes
cv_earthquakes <- unique(
  train_data$publicid
)


# Randomly assign whole earthquakes to folds
fold_assignment <- tibble(
  publicid = sample(
    cv_earthquakes
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    fold = rep(
      1:k,
      length.out = n()
    )
  )


# Add fold number to each cell
train_cv <- train_data |>
  left_join(
    fold_assignment,
    by = "publicid"
  )


# Check number of earthquakes in each fold
fold_assignment |>
  count(fold)

# LINEAR MODEL CROSS-VALIDATION
cv_lr_results <- tibble()


for (i in 1:k) {

  cat(
    "Linear model CV fold",
    i,
    "of",
    k,
    "\n"
  )

  # Training and validation data
  fold_train <- train_cv |>
    filter(
      fold != i
    )


  fold_validation <- train_cv |>
    filter(
      fold == i
    )

  # Find Box-Cox lambda using ONLY fold training data
  bc_fit <- lm(
    reported_mmi ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      Repi_km +
      Vs30_m_s,
    data = fold_train
  )


  bc <- MASS::boxcox(
    bc_fit,
    plotit = FALSE
  )


  fold_lambda <- bc$x[
    which.max(bc$y)
  ]

  # Transform response
  fold_train <- fold_train |>
    mutate(
      reported_mmi_bc =
        boxcox_transform(
          reported_mmi,
          fold_lambda
        )
    )

  # Model 1
  # Linear Repi + linear Vs30
  model_1 <- lm(
    reported_mmi_bc ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      Repi_km +
      Vs30_m_s,
    data = fold_train
  )

  # Model 2
  # Log Repi + linear Vs30
  model_2 <- lm(
    reported_mmi_bc ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      Vs30_m_s,
    data = fold_train
  )

  # Model 3
  # Linear Repi + log Vs30
  model_3 <- lm(
    reported_mmi_bc ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      Repi_km +
      log10(Vs30_m_s),
    data = fold_train
  )

  # Model 4
  # Log Repi + log Vs30
  model_4 <- lm(
    reported_mmi_bc ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      log10(Vs30_m_s),
    data = fold_train
  )

  # Model 5
  # Linear + log Repi + linear Vs30
  model_5 <- lm(
    reported_mmi_bc ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      Repi_km +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      Vs30_m_s,
    data = fold_train
  )

  # Model 6
  # Linear + log Repi + log Vs30
  model_6 <- lm(
    reported_mmi_bc ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      Repi_km +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      log10(Vs30_m_s),
    data = fold_train
  )


  models <- list(

    "Linear Repi + linear Vs30" =
      model_1,

    "Log10 Repi + linear Vs30" =
      model_2,

    "Linear Repi + log10 Vs30" =
      model_3,

    "Log10 Repi + log10 Vs30" =
      model_4,

    "Linear + log10 Repi + linear Vs30" =
      model_5,

    "Linear + log10 Repi + log10 Vs30" =
      model_6

  )

  # Predict validation earthquakes
  for (model_name in names(models)) {

    pred_bc <- predict(
      models[[model_name]],
      newdata = fold_validation
    )

    # Back-transform to original MMI scale
    pred_mmi <- inverse_boxcox(
      pred_bc,
      fold_lambda
    )
    
cat(
  "Fold:", i,
  "| Model:", model_name,
  "| Total:", length(pred_mmi),
  "| Missing predictions:", sum(is.na(pred_mmi)),
  "| Invalid inverse domain:",
  sum(
    is.finite(pred_bc) &
      1 + fold_lambda * pred_bc <= 0
  ),
  "\n"
)

    # Calculate RMSE
    rmse <- sqrt(
      mean(
        (
          fold_validation$reported_mmi -
            pred_mmi
        )^2,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )

    # Save result
    cv_lr_results <- bind_rows(
      cv_lr_results,
      tibble(
        fold = i,
        model = model_name,
        lambda = fold_lambda,
        RMSE = rmse
      )
    )

  }

}

# MIXED MODEL CROSS-VALIDATION
cv_mixed_results <- tibble()


for (i in 1:k) {

  cat(
    "Mixed model CV fold",
    i,
    "of",
    k,
    "\n"
  )

  # Training and validation data
  fold_train <- train_cv |>
    filter(
      fold != i
    )


  fold_validation <- train_cv |>
    filter(
      fold == i
    )

  # Model 1
  # Linear Repi + linear Vs30
  mixed_1 <- lmer(
    reported_mmi ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      Repi_km +
      Vs30_m_s +
      (1 + Repi_km | publicid),
    data = fold_train,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  # Model 2
  # Log Repi + linear Vs30
  mixed_2 <- lmer(
    reported_mmi ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      Vs30_m_s +
      (1 + log10(Repi_km) | publicid),
    data = fold_train,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  # Model 3
  # Linear + log Repi + log Vs30
  mixed_3 <- lmer(
    reported_mmi ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      Repi_km +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      log10(Vs30_m_s) +
      (1 + log10(Repi_km) | publicid),
    data = fold_train,
    REML = FALSE
  )


  mixed_models <- list(

    "Linear Repi + linear Vs30" =
      mixed_1,

    "Log10 Repi + linear Vs30" =
      mixed_2,

    "Linear + log10 Repi + log10 Vs30" =
      mixed_3

  )

  # Predict unseen earthquakes
  for (model_name in names(mixed_models)) {

    pred <- predict(
      mixed_models[[model_name]],
      newdata = fold_validation,
      re.form = NA,
      allow.new.levels = TRUE
    )

    # RMSE
    rmse <- sqrt(
      mean(
        (
          fold_validation$reported_mmi -
            pred
        )^2,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )

    cv_mixed_results <- bind_rows(
      cv_mixed_results,
      tibble(
        fold = i,
        model = model_name,
        RMSE = rmse
      )
    )

  }

}

# RESPONSE TRANSFORMATION CROSS-VALIDATION

# Compare:
#   1. Raw MMI
#   2. Log MMI
#   3. Box-Cox MMI

# Predictor structure is kept the same.
cv_transform_results <- tibble()


for (i in 1:k) {

  cat(
    "Transformation CV fold",
    i,
    "of",
    k,
    "\n"
  )

  # Training and validation data
  fold_train <- train_cv |>
    filter(
      fold != i
    )


  fold_validation <- train_cv |>
    filter(
      fold == i
    )

  # Find Box-Cox lambda from fold training data
  bc_fit <- lm(
    reported_mmi ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      Vs30_m_s,
    data = fold_train
  )


  bc <- MASS::boxcox(
    bc_fit,
    plotit = FALSE
  )


  fold_lambda <- bc$x[
    which.max(bc$y)
  ]


  fold_train <- fold_train |>
    mutate(
      reported_mmi_bc =
        boxcox_transform(
          reported_mmi,
          fold_lambda
        )
    )

  # Raw MMI model
  model_raw <- lmer(
    reported_mmi ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      Vs30_m_s +
      (1 + log10(Repi_km) | publicid),
    data = fold_train,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  # Log MMI model
  model_log <- lmer(
    log(reported_mmi) ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      Vs30_m_s +
      (1 + log10(Repi_km) | publicid),
    data = fold_train,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  # Box-Cox MMI model
  model_bc <- lmer(
    reported_mmi_bc ~
      event_depth_km +
      Mw +
      log10(Repi_km) +
      Vs30_m_s +
      (1 + log10(Repi_km) | publicid),
    data = fold_train,
    REML = FALSE
  )

  # Raw predictions
  pred_raw <- predict(
    model_raw,
    newdata = fold_validation,
    re.form = NA,
    allow.new.levels = TRUE
  )

  # Log predictions
  # Back-transform with exp()
  pred_log <- exp(
    predict(
      model_log,
      newdata = fold_validation,
      re.form = NA,
      allow.new.levels = TRUE
    )
  )

  # Box-Cox predictions
  pred_bc_transformed <- predict(
    model_bc,
    newdata = fold_validation,
    re.form = NA,
    allow.new.levels = TRUE
  )


  pred_bc <- inverse_boxcox(
    pred_bc_transformed,
    fold_lambda
  )

  # RMSE
  rmse_raw <- sqrt(
    mean(
      (
        fold_validation$reported_mmi -
          pred_raw
      )^2,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


  rmse_log <- sqrt(
    mean(
      (
        fold_validation$reported_mmi -
          pred_log
      )^2,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


  rmse_bc <- sqrt(
    mean(
      (
        fold_validation$reported_mmi -
          pred_bc
      )^2,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


  # Save results
  cv_transform_results <- bind_rows(
    cv_transform_results,

    tibble(
      fold = i,
      transformation = c(
        "Raw MMI",
        "Log MMI",
        "Box-Cox MMI"
      ),
      lambda = c(
        NA,
        NA,
        fold_lambda
      ),
      RMSE = c(
        rmse_raw,
        rmse_log,
        rmse_bc
      )
    )
  )

}

# COEFFICIENT TABLE WITH CLUSTER-ROBUST STANDARD ERRORS

# 1. Calculate cluster-robust covariance matrix
# Group observations by earthquake (publicid)

  final_lm,
  cluster = train_data$publicid,

)

# 2. Extract coefficient estimates and robust standard errors

  final_lm,
  vcov. = cluster_vcov,
  df = Inf
)

# 3. Calculate 95% confidence intervals
coefficient_table <- data.frame(
  Predictor = rownames(coefficient_results),
  Estimate = coefficient_results[, 1],
  Robust_SE = coefficient_results[, 2],
  CI_lower = coefficient_results[, 1] -
    1.96 * coefficient_results[, 2],
  CI_upper = coefficient_results[, 1] +
    1.96 * coefficient_results[, 2],
  p_value = coefficient_results[, 4]
) |>
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ signif(.x, 4)
    )
  )

# DUAN'S SMEARING ESTIMATOR
# Compare original and bias-corrected Box-Cox predictions

# 1. GET TRAINING RESIDUALS
# Residuals are on the Box-Cox transformed scale
train_residuals <- residuals(final_lm)


# 2. PREDICT TEST DATA ON BOX-COX SCALE
pred_bc <- predict(
  final_lm,
  newdata = test_data
)


# 3. ORIGINAL PREDICTIONS
pred_original <- inverse_boxcox(
  pred_bc,
  best_lambda_final
)


# 4. DUAN'S SMEARING CORRECTION
# Average back-transformed predictions after adding
# residuals from the training data
smearing_predict <- function(
  pred_bc,
  residuals,
  lambda
) {

  sapply(pred_bc, function(pred) {

    # Add training residuals to prediction
    adjusted_bc <- pred + residuals

    # Check which values can be back-transformed
    if (abs(lambda) < 1e-8) {

      valid <- is.finite(adjusted_bc)

    } else {

      valid <- is.finite(adjusted_bc) &
        (1 + lambda * adjusted_bc > 0)

    }

    # If no valid combinations remain
    if (!any(valid)) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    # Back-transform only valid combinations
    adjusted <- inverse_boxcox(
      adjusted_bc[valid],
      lambda
    )

    # Average back-transformed values
    mean(adjusted)

  })
}

# Calculate Duan's smearing-corrected predictions
pred_smeared <- smearing_predict(
  pred_bc,
  train_residuals,
  best_lambda_final
)

# 5. CREATE COMPARISON DATASET
smearing_results <- test_data |>
  mutate(
    predicted_original = pred_original,
    predicted_smeared = pred_smeared,
    mmi_category = floor(reported_mmi + 0.5)
  ) |>
  filter(
    is.finite(predicted_original),
    is.finite(predicted_smeared),
    !is.na(reported_mmi)
  )


# 6. OVERALL PERFORMANCE COMPARISON
smearing_overall <- smearing_results |>
  summarise(
    original_MAE = mean(
      abs(predicted_original - reported_mmi)
    ),

    smeared_MAE = mean(
      abs(predicted_smeared - reported_mmi)
    ),

    original_RMSE = sqrt(
      mean((predicted_original - reported_mmi)^2)
    ),

    smeared_RMSE = sqrt(
      mean((predicted_smeared - reported_mmi)^2)
    )
  )

# FIND DISTANCE OF EACH MMI BOUNDARY
ring_distances <- map_dfr(
  mmi_boundaries,
  function(boundary) {

    closest <- prediction_data |>
      slice_min(
        abs(predicted_mmi - boundary),
        n = 1,
        with_ties = FALSE
      )

    tibble(
      boundary = boundary,
      Repi_km = closest$Repi_km,
      predicted_mmi = closest$predicted_mmi
    )

  }
)


print(ring_distances)

# CREATE MMI RINGS
rings <- ring_distances |>
  mutate(
    radius_km = pmin(
      Repi_km,
      max_radius_km
    ),
    mmi = ceiling(boundary)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(radius_km))

# CREATE CIRCLE GEOMETRY
ring_geometry <- lapply(
  rings$radius_km,
  function(radius) {

    st_buffer(
      st_geometry(earthquake),
      dist = radius * 1000
    )[[1]]

  }
)


rings_sf <- st_sf(

  boundary = rings$boundary,

  radius_km = rings$radius_km,

  mmi = rings$mmi,

  geometry = st_sfc(
    ring_geometry,
    crs = 2193
  )

)

rings_sf$mmi <- factor(rings_sf$mmi, levels = 3:8)

# MMI COLOURS
mmi_colours <- c(
  "3" = "#BFCCFF",
  "4" = "#A0E6FF",

)

# CREATE MAP
mmi_map <- ggplot() +

  # NZ map
  geom_sf(
    data = nz_nztm,
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "grey60",
    linewidth = 0.25
  ) +

  # Predicted MMI regions
  # Largest circles are plotted first
  geom_sf(
    data = rings_sf,
    aes(
      fill = mmi
    ),
    colour = "grey35",
    linewidth = 0.35,
    alpha = 0.45
  ) +

  # NZ boundaries drawn above predicted circles
  # Keeps New Zealand visible behind the circles
  geom_sf(
    data = nz_nztm,
    fill = NA,
    colour = "grey45",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +

  # Observed MMI at Felt RAPID cells
  geom_sf(
    data = eq_sf,
    aes(fill = observed_mmi_category),
    shape = 21,
    colour = "black",
    stroke = 0.2,
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.95,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  # Earthquake epicentre
  geom_sf(
    data = earthquake,
    shape = 4,
    size = 4,
    stroke = 1.5
  ) +

  # North arrow
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "tr",
    which_north = "true",
    pad_x = unit(0.3, "in"),
    pad_y = unit(0.3, "in"),
    height = unit(0.8, "cm"),
    width = unit(0.8, "cm"),
    style = north_arrow_minimal
  ) +
  
    # Scale bar
  annotation_scale(
    location = "br",
    width_hint = 0.25,
    unit_category = "metric",
    style = "bar",
    pad_x = unit(0.3, "in"),
    pad_y = unit(0.3, "in"),
    text_cex = 0.8,
    line_width = 0.7
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = mmi_colours,
    limits = as.character(3:8),
    name = "MMI",
    guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Observed and Predicted Earthquake Intensity",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Earthquake: ", earthquake_id,
      " | Mw: ", round(mw_value, 2),
      " | Depth: ", round(depth, 1), " km"
    ),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +

  # Focus map on New Zealand
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(
      nz_bbox["xmin"] - x_margin,
      nz_bbox["xmax"] + x_margin
    ),
    ylim = c(
      nz_bbox["ymin"] - y_margin,
      nz_bbox["ymax"] + y_margin
    ),
    expand = FALSE,
    datum = NA
  ) +

  theme_void() +

  theme(
    legend.position = "right",

    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

# MAP PREDICTED MMI FOR A HYPOTHETICAL EARTHQUAKE

# Alpine fault
# event_longitude <- 171
# event_latitude <- -42.7
# mw_value <- 8
# depth <- 10

# HYPOTHETICAL EARTHQUAKE SETTINGS
earthquake_name <- "Hypothetical Alpine Fault Earthquake"

event_longitude <- 171
event_latitude <- -42.7
mw_value <- 8
depth <- 10

# NEW ZEALAND MAP
nz_nztm <- nzmap |>
  st_transform(2193)

# Remove Chatham Islands
mainland_bbox <- st_bbox(
  c(
    xmin = 1000000,
    ymin = 4700000,
    xmax = 2100000,
    ymax = 6300000
  ),
  crs = st_crs(2193)
)

nz_nztm <- st_crop(nz_nztm, mainland_bbox)

nz_bbox <- st_bbox(nz_nztm)

x_margin <- (nz_bbox["xmax"] - nz_bbox["xmin"]) * 0.20
y_margin <- (nz_bbox["ymax"] - nz_bbox["ymin"]) * 0.10


# CREATE HYPOTHETICAL EARTHQUAKE EPICENTRE
earthquake <- tibble(
  event_longitude = event_longitude,
  event_latitude = event_latitude
) |>
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("event_longitude", "event_latitude"),
    crs = 4326
  ) |>
  st_transform(2193)


# MAXIMUM DISTANCE ACROSS NEW ZEALAND
# Use all four corners so the prediction covers the map

bbox_corners <- st_as_sf(
  expand.grid(
    x = c(nz_bbox["xmin"], nz_bbox["xmax"]),
    y = c(nz_bbox["ymin"], nz_bbox["ymax"])
  ),
  coords = c("x", "y"),
  crs = 2193
)

max_radius_km <- max(
  as.numeric(
    st_distance(
      st_geometry(earthquake),
      st_geometry(bbox_corners)
    )
  )
) / 1000


# HOLD VS30 CONSTANT
# Use median Vs30 from the modelling dataset
vs30_value <- median(
  data_sd$Vs30_m_s,
  na.rm = TRUE
)


# GENERATE EPICENTRAL DISTANCES
prediction_data <- tibble(
  Repi_km = seq(
    from = 0.1,
    to = max_radius_km,
    by = 0.1
  ),
  event_depth_km = depth,
  Mw = mw_value,
  Vs30_m_s = vs30_value
)


# PREDICT MMI USING FINAL LINEAR MODEL
prediction_bc <- predict(
  final_lm,
  newdata = prediction_data
)

prediction_data$predicted_mmi <- inverse_boxcox(
  prediction_bc,
  best_lambda_final
)


# CHECK PREDICTION RANGE
print(
  range(
    prediction_data$predicted_mmi,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)
